context_for_next_testing_agent: Login workaround still required for ryan@ryan.com: the TouchableOpacity at testID='auth-submit' does NOT submit reliably from Playwright clicks. Workaround: POST /api/auth/login from Python, then `await page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.token', '<token>')")` before page.goto('/'). Note /api/auth/login is rate-limited 5/min/IP — cache tokens or pace test runs. The HISTORY tab on the tool detail page is part of a horizontally-scrollable segmented control (Details | Set | Photos | Documents | Maintenance | Warranty | History) — in a 390px viewport History is OFF-SCREEN to the right and a get_by_text('History').click() doesn't reliably switch the panel; you'll likely need to scroll the segmented row horizontally or use a more specific testID. Dealer transactions live at dd['transactions'] (top-level array), NOT inside `accounts.personal.transactions` — older helper paths return None. POST /api/dealers/{id}/transactions response returns the dealer object (not the new tx) — to get the tx_id, re-GET the dealer and pick the latest tx that matches your TEST_ note.
